stem: These quotations provide evidence that both the speaker in “To a Daughter with Artistic Talent” and the narrator in the excerpt from Big Fish feel —

options.label: F
options.text: as though they must prove something

visual_elements:
To a Daughter with Artistic Talent
And you never know why (I was lying before when I said I knew).

Big Fish
I don’t know what makes a man great. I’ve never thought about it before.
